ui.. Select which data sources you consent: . Select which data sources you consent to share. Mandatory items are required to proceed. Optional items improve your score accuracy.

ui.Available patterns are weighted into a d: Available patterns are weighted into a descriptive score. Missing factors are omitted and the remaining weights are renormalized. These points are not credit-model logit contributions.
ui.. No missing income consistency or debt: . No missing income consistency or debt history is assumed.
ui.Signed contributions are changes to the: Signed contributions are changes to the model’s default log-odds, not score points or causal effects. A positive contribution raises the model’s estimated default propensity; a negative contribution lowers it.

Successive transaction balances checked. This statement has no labelled opening or closing balance; the score covers the uploaded activity.

ui.Heuristic signals indicate items to revi: Heuristic signals indicate items to review. They do not prove fraud and do not change either displayed score.
ui.. Transaction findings are separate from: . Transaction findings are separate from identity verification.

ui.PRISM’s experimental score has no RBI el: PRISM’s experimental score has no RBI eligibility band. These protections apply independently of the score; lenders assess applications under their own policies.
ui.Request one free full credit report per: Request one free full credit report per calendar year from each credit information company holding your history. Review repayment entries and dispute errors.
ui.For digital lending, review the lender’s: For digital lending, review the lender’s Key Facts Statement, annual percentage rate, charges and repayment terms before agreeing. Check the disclosed cooling-off option.
ui.Know how to raise a complaint: Know how to raise a complaint
ui.Contact the regulated lender’s grievance: Contact the regulated lender’s grievance officer first. If unresolved after 30 days, or you receive an unsatisfactory response, review eligibility for RBI’s complaint process.
ui.These are PRISM next steps, not an RBI r: These are PRISM next steps, not an RBI recommendation for a particular score.
ui.Sources checked 11 October 2026. This pr: Sources checked 11 October 2026. This prototype does not establish regulatory compliance or replace the lender’s assessment.

ui.Your latest saved assessment does not co: Your latest saved assessment does not contain a score.

ui.These figures summarize transactions fou: These figures summarize transactions found in your latest uploaded assessment. They do not classify purchases into merchant categories.
ui.Assessment time shows when PRISM process: Assessment time shows when PRISM processed the upload. Statement dates come from the document itself.

ui.Fraud review details are not available f: Fraud review details are not available for this saved assessment.

ui.Hypothetical output from the current exp: Hypothetical output from the current experimental formula. It is not a prediction of lender approval or repayment.
ui.PRISM’s observed-pattern score has no RB: PRISM’s observed-pattern score has no RBI-defined eligibility band. These resources describe general protections and do not imply RBI approval of PRISM.
ui.RBI rules do not map this experimental c: RBI rules do not map this experimental cash-flow score to a lending decision. Lenders apply their own policies and assess the full application.
ui.Individuals with credit history can requ: Individuals with credit history can request one free full credit report per calendar year from each credit information company that holds their data. Review entries and raise errors with the relevant institution.
ui.Before accepting a covered loan, read th: Before accepting a covered loan, read the lender’s Key Facts Statement and compare the annual percentage rate, fees, repayment schedule and other terms.
ui.Contact the regulated lender first. If t: Contact the regulated lender first. If the issue remains unresolved, check the current eligibility and process for the Reserve Bank–Integrated Ombudsman Scheme.
ui.RBI source pages checked 12 October 2026: RBI source pages checked 12 October 2026. Guidance is general information, not legal advice.
ui.See what was measured, how the descripti: See what was measured, how the descriptive score is formed and where its limits are.
ui.Available measures come from dated credi: Available measures come from dated credits, debits and balances in your bank statement. A measure that cannot be observed stays unknown; it is not treated as zero.
ui.The displayed range summarizes cash-flow: The displayed range summarizes cash-flow patterns found in supplied statement rows. It is experimental and is not a bureau score, probability of default, or lending recommendation.
ui.Fraud checks run separately. A heuristic: Fraud checks run separately. A heuristic flag prompts review of the underlying record; it does not establish wrongdoing.
ui.Use the monthly view to compare observed: Use the monthly view to compare observed periods and the simulator to explore hypothetical changes. Neither modifies a saved assessment.
